story.title: 2 minors killed, 3 others seriously injured after van crashes and catches fire in Fort Worth
story.summary: A Toyota Sienna overturned and caught fire near a creek in north Fort Worth, not far from the Stockyards. The driver and another passenger, both minors, died at the scene; two juveniles and an 18-year-old were taken to the hospital with serious injuries. A Texas DPS trooper had tried to stop the speeding van about half a mile away but lost sight of it before finding the crash. DPS is investigating.
